chunks: 1 – Al-Ḥasan b. Rāshid, client of Manṭūr, Abū Muḥammad. Narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh and Abū al--Ḥasan Mūsā (peace be upon them).

key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak (in terms of reliability in hadith transmission)
key_terms.مَوْلَى: Client or freedman, indicating social status

ai.seo_question: Who is Al-asan ibn Rashid and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of al-Du'afa (The Weak) identifies Al-asan ibn Rashid as a narrator of the Imams, specifically Abu Abdillah and Abu al-Hasan Musa, but classifies him as weak (da'if) in his transmission of hadith.
